name: BlessAI – blessing cards for WooCommerce
author: BlessAI team

sections.description:
The BlessAI plugin enhances your e-commerce checkout experience by offering personalized gift messages crafted through artificial intelligence. During checkout, customers can access an elegant expandable card form where they input key details like the sender’s name, recipient, special occasion, and preferred design theme.

The AI engine then composes a thoughtful, tailored message that perfectly captures the sentiment. When processing orders, one can easily print these custom blessings and include them with their shipments, adding a meaningful personal touch to every package.

🚀 Try BlessAI Live Demo – See it in action before you install!

Experience the full functionality of BlessAI with our interactive demo. Test the AI blessing generation, explore different card designs, and see how seamlessly it integrates with your checkout process.

🎯 Perfect For

  • Flower shops and florists
  • Gift shops and gift basket stores
  • Women’s fashion and accessories boutiques
  • Men’s fashion and accessories stores
  • Specialty and concept shops
  • Online gift marketplaces
  • Custom gift retailers
  • Any store wanting to add personalized blessings to their products

✨ Key Features

AI-Powered Blessing Generation
* Creates heartfelt, personalized blessings based on customer input
* Supports multiple occasions (weddings, birthdays, graduations, etc.)
* Maintains appropriate tone and cultural sensitivity
* Allows customers to customize and edit suggested blessings

Beautiful Card Designs
* Elegant frame templates for every occasion
* High-quality printable outputs
* Customizable layouts and designs
* Support for both digital and print formats
* Easy integration with popular printing services

Multilingual Support
* Generate blessings in multiple languages ()
* Full support for RTL languages (Arabic, Hebrew, etc.)
* Language-specific fonts and layouts
* Interface available in multiple languages

Easy Integration
* Seamless WooCommerce integration
* Simple product setup
* Customizable pricing for different card types
* Bulk order support
* Easy order management

Print-Ready Output
* High-resolution PDF generation
* Print-optimized color profiles
* Bleed and crop mark options
* Multiple size formats (A4, A5, US Letter, etc.)
* Digital delivery formats

🌐 Live Demo

Visit our demo store at https://blessai.co/

Try BlessAI risk-free with our fully functional demo:
* Add products to cart and proceed to checkout
* Experience the blessing card creation process
* Test AI-generated messages with different occasions
* Preview printable card designs
* See the complete customer journey

🔧 Shop Requirements

  • WooCommerce installed and activated
  • An active account with one of these Artificial Intelligence providers (optional for AI generated texts):
    • OpenAI (ChatGPT)
    • Anthropic (Claude)
    • Google (Gemini)
  • Printer requirements:
    • Color printer recommended (black & white acceptable)
    • Supports small paper formats (A5, A6, 6″x4″)
    • Standard A4 also supported

🔄 How It Works

1. Order Process
* Customer checks the “Add BlessCard” option during checkout
* Option appears automatically on your checkout page

2. Blessing Creation
* Customer fills in simple fields:
* From (sender’s name)
* To (recipient’s name)
* Occasion (dropdown with customizable options)
* Clicks [Generate Blessing] button
* AI creates unique, heartwarming message
* Customer can edit or regenerate the text, and also select font and frame

3. Card Printing
* Merchant sees orders in WooCommerce dashboard
* A simple [Print BlessCard] button for each order with a blessing
* Automatically formats card with:
* Beautiful frame design
* Customer’s blessing text
* Professional layout

🚀 Business Benefits

  • Increase average order value with personalized offerings
  • Save time with AI-generated content
  • Reduce customer service load with automated blessing generation
  • Stand out with unique, personalized service

💡 Use Cases

  1. Flower Shops

    • Perfect for all bouquet orders
    • Special occasions: Valentine’s Day, Mother’s Day, anniversaries
    • Get-well wishes with flower deliveries
    • Wedding bouquet accompaniments

  2. Gift Shops

    • Birthday celebrations for all ages
    • Wedding and engagement presents
    • New baby congratulations
    • Holiday season gifts (New Year, Christmas)
    • Housewarming and graduation gifts

  3. Women’s Fashion & Accessories

    • Personal shopping experiences
    • Birthday and anniversary gifts
    • Mother’s Day specials
    • Bridal accessories
    • Special occasion outfits

  4. Men’s Fashion & Accessories

    • Father’s Day gifts
    • Anniversary presents
    • Birthday celebrations
    • Business success congratulations
    • Graduation achievements

  5. Specialty & Concept Stores

    • Custom gift baskets
    • Corporate gift packages
    • Holiday season specials
    • Personal milestone celebrations
    • Retirement and achievement gifts

🌍 Language Support

  • English
  • Spanish
  • French
  • German
  • Arabic (RTL)
  • Hebrew (RTL)
  • [More languages regularly added]

🛠️ Technical Features

  • Regular AI model updates
  • Secure data handling
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Performance optimized
  • Regular security updates

🔐 Privacy & Security

  • No Personal Data Storage Outside Your Site

    • All blessing texts stored only in your WooCommerce orders
    • Customer information remains within your website
    • Complete control over your data

  • Secure AI Integration

    • Your AI API keys stored securely in your WordPress database
    • No external storage of authentication credentials
    • Direct API communication with chosen AI provider

  • GDPR Compliant

    • Clear data handling processes
    • No unnecessary data collection

External Services

BlessAI uses both third-party AI services and BlessAI’s own API services

BlessAI API Services

This plugin connects to BlessAI’s own API services to provide blessing card functionality and shop management features.

Blessing Generation Service (https://blessai.co/api/get_card_text.php)
* What it does: Processes blessing card generation requests by coordinating with your chosen AI provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google)
* When data is sent: Only when a customer clicks “Generate Blessing” during checkout
* Data sent:
– Sender’s name and gender (optional)
– Recipient’s name and gender (optional)
– Occasion being celebrated
– Relationship context (optional)
– Selected language, font, frame, and text color
– Your domain name (for service validation)
– Your AI provider API key (securely transmitted)
– Selected AI engine preference

Shop Information Service (https://blessai.co/api/shop_info.php)
* What it does: Manages your shop’s service plan and usage tracking for the BlessAI service
* When data is sent: When accessing BlessAI admin settings and periodically for usage validation
* Data sent:
– Your domain name
– Shop contact details (optional)
– Admin email address
– Service usage statistics

Data Security: All communications with BlessAI services are encrypted via HTTPS. No sensitive customer data like payment information or addresses is transmitted.

This service is provided by BlessAI: Terms of Use | Privacy Policy

Third-Party AI Services

BlessAI uses third-party AI services to generate personalized blessing messages

What Services Are Used

  • OpenAI (ChatGPT) – AI text generation service
  • Anthropic (Claude) – AI text generation service
  • Google (Gemini) – AI text generation service

What the Services Do

These AI services are used exclusively to generate personalized blessing card messages based on customer input during the checkout process. The services analyze the provided information (sender name, recipient name, occasion, relationship) and create appropriate blessing text.

When Data is Sent

Data is transmitted to the selected AI service only when:
* A customer chooses to add a blessing card during checkout
* The customer clicks the “Generate Blessing” button
* The plugin processes the blessing generation request

What Data is Sent

The following customer-provided information is sent to the AI service:
* Sender’s name (From field)
* Sender’s gender (optional)
* Recipient’s name (To field)
* Recipient’s gender (optional)
* Occasion being celebrated
* Relationship context (optional)
* Selected language for the blessing
* Your domain name (for validation)

Important: No payment information, addresses, phone numbers, or other sensitive data is sent to AI services.

Data Processing

  • All communication with AI services is encrypted via HTTPS
  • Your API keys are stored securely in your WordPress database
  • Generated blessing text is stored in your WooCommerce order data
  • No customer data is permanently stored by the AI service providers

Privacy and Terms Links

Before using BlessAI, please review the privacy policies and terms of service for your chosen AI provider:

OpenAI (ChatGPT)
* Privacy Policy: https://openai.com/privacy/
* Terms of Use: https://openai.com/terms/
* API Terms: https://openai.com/api-terms

Anthropic (Claude)
* Privacy Policy: https://www.anthropic.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://www.anthropic.com/terms
* API Terms: https://console.anthropic.com/legal/terms

Google (Gemini)
* Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
* AI Terms: https://ai.google.dev/terms

Your Responsibility

By using BlessAI, you agree to:
* Inform your customers that AI services are used for blessing generation
* Comply with your chosen AI provider’s terms of service
* Ensure you have appropriate permissions to send customer data to third-party services
* Review and comply with applicable data protection regulations (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)

Opt-Out Options

  • Customers can choose not to add blessing cards to their orders
  • You can disable AI generation and allow manual blessing text entry only
  • You maintain full control over when and how the service is used

💪 Premium Support

  • Dedicated support team
  • Documentation and tutorials
  • Regular updates
  • Priority bug fixes
  • Community forum access
sections.installation:
🛠️ Installation Instructions

Before installing, try our live demo to see BlessAI in action!

  1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/blessai directory, or install through WordPress plugins screen
  2. Activate the plugin through ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Go to BlessAI settings page under WooCommerce menu
  4. Enter your AI provider credentials
  5. Test the system with a sample order

AI Provider Setup

Detailed guides for setting up each AI provider are available here.

ChatGPT Setup

  • Step 1: Create an OpenAI Account
    Head over to https://openai.com/ and click on the “Sign Up” button. Follow the instructions and verify your email address.

  • Step 2: Navigate to the API Section
    Once you’ve logged into your OpenAI account, look for the “API” tab or navigate to https://platform.openai.com/signup to access the API dashboard directly.

  • Step 3: Choose the Plan
    Select the plan that best fits your needs. Choose a paid plan.

  • Step 4: Read and Agree to the Terms
    Understand the usage limitations, privacy policies and agree.

  • Step 5: Complete Billing Information
    Provide your billing information. Fill in the necessary details, such as your name, billing address, and payment method. OpenAI accepts various payment options, including credit cards.

  • Step 6: Generate the API Key
    After completing the billing information, you’ll see your API key.

  • Step 7: Setup BlessAI
    On BlessAI admin page (WooCommerce => BlessAI), select ChatGPT as the AI agent, copy-paste the API key into the API key field and click Save Changes button.

  • Step 8: Test and Experiment
    In your store. add a prouct to the shopping cart and move on to the checkout page. Check the checkbox next to Add a personalized blessing card? You will see the blessAI form. fill in some fields and click on the Generate Blessing button. After few seconds you should see in the textarea the AI generated text.

Claude Setup

  • Step 1: Create an Anthropic account
    First, go to the Anthropic console, and create a developer account at https://console.anthropic.com/login and follow the wizard until yo see the ANTHROPIC dashboard.

  • Step 2: Add credits to your account
    Click Billing on the left-side menu. Click on Complete Setup button and follow the wizard to add billing information and buy credit to be able to use the API.

  • Step 3: Get a Claude API key
    Select Dashboard from the top menu. Click on Create Key button, name it and copy the shown API key.

  • Step 4: Setup BlessAI
    On BlessAI admin page (WooCommerce => BlessAI), select ChatGPT as the AI agent, copy-paste the API key into the API key field and click Save Changes button.

  • Step 5: Test and Experiment
    In your store. add a prouct to the shopping cart and move on to the checkout page. Check the checkbox next to Add a personalized blessing card? You will see the blessAI form. fill in some fields and click on the Generate Blessing button. After few seconds you should see in the textarea the AI generated text.

Gemini Setup

  • Step 1: Create a Google AI Studio account
    Go to the Gemini API website, https://ai.google.dev/aistudio, and click Sign In to Google AI Studio. Follow the steps to create a new account or sign in with your existing Google credentials.

  • Step 2: Get a Gemini API key
    Once you log in to Google AI Studio, read, accept, and close the informational pop-ups that appear on your screen. On the top left of the screen, click the Get API key button. Then click the Create API key button. Accept and close the safety setting reminder. After that, click the Create API key in new project button. Google will create a new API key. Copy that key, and then close the pop-up.

  • Step 3: Setup BlessAI
    On BlessAI admin page (WooCommerce => BlessAI), select ChatGPT as the AI agent, copy-paste the API key into the API key field and click Save Changes button.

  • Step 4: Test and Experiment
    In your store. add a prouct to the shopping cart and move on to the checkout page. Check the checkbox next to Add a personalized blessing card? You will see the blessAI form. fill in some fields and click on the Generate Blessing button. After few seconds you should see in the textarea the AI generated text.
sections.faq:
Which AI provider should I choose?

All supported providers (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) offer excellent results. Choose based on:
* Pricing preferences
* Available languages

Can I test BlessAI before installing?

Yes! Visit our live demo at https://blessai.co/ to try all features before installation.

Can I customize the card designs?

This feature is on our roadmap.

What paper size should I use?

We recommend A5 or 6″x4″ for greeting cards, but the plugin supports multiple sizes including:
* A6 (105 × 148 mm)
* A5 (148 × 210 mm)
* 6″ × 4″ (152 × 102 mm)
* A4 (210 × 297 mm)

Is the plugin compatible with my theme?

BlessAI is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce.

How do I get support?

Support is available through:
* Our support ticket system
* Documentation portal
* Community forum
